about: Nothing but bad shots, one day / one outfit (green striped polo, khakis, white cap) from your Oct 21 Golf Tracer 2 clips. 9 bits back to back, each cut before you talk: opens on the driver you hit 'four inches in front of the ball', then the chunk that 'took a whole chunk out of the ground', the shot into the bunker ('trip to the beach'), 'what the heck was that', the 'atrocious' one, the bunker shot ('oh no'), the hay-stack shot, the one you 'hate that you had to see', and 'not a good drive'. Natural sound only, no music, no text, no shirt wipe (each clip's opening wipe is skipped). Transcript of the final file: empty (no speech). 32 s.
